What clients come for

From what clients write on Google.

Medical pedicure

Many reviews are about the medical pedicure. Clients write that they also get advice on keeping their feet healthy.

Manicure

Manicure, gel manicure and nail art. One client mentions a great choice of colours.

Hands and feet together

Clients describe manicure and pedicure at the same time, with two technicians working together.

A studio on Anexartisias

ONYX nail studio is at Anexartisias 28 in Paphos, in Nearchos Court, with the teal ONYX letters on the glass front. Inside are pedicure chairs with massage, a bright reception and a room for sterilising tools. Clients come for healthy nails as much as for beautiful ones.
